blockingFindingsInFiniteScope.title: Default DiziYou buffered delivery exhausts enclosing Hub deadline before first callback
evidence: CloudStreamHub.kt:420-448 starts that timeout before provider search/load; lines 534-538 invoke provider.loadLinks inside it
DiziYou.kt:339 fetches the episode document inside the same deadline; lines 349-350 default to 20000 ms discovery plus 10000 ms preflight
DiziYou.kt:277-323 constructs two distinct native HTTP candidates; lines 355-362 collect those and all fallback extractor callbacks before shared delivery

BoundedParallelResolver.kt:27 defaults earlyExitOnFirstSuccess to false and line 78 awaits resolver jobs, allowing a fallback that emits six distinct HTTP links then awaits cancellation to consume the discovery budget
BoundedLinkDelivery.kt:37-54 completes discovery before preflight; lines 55-70 use concurrency four and a 5000 ms probe timeout; lines 75-82 wait for the whole preflight phase before any callback
blockingFindingsInFiniteScope.concreteCondition: A valid player ID gives two native links; one fallback extractor emits six distinct HTTP links then remains pending until the 20-second discovery timeout. All eight HTTP probes suspend for their five-second per-probe timeout. Four permits require two waves, consuming the ten-second preflight budget. Even without scheduling overhead, delivery cannot begin before 30 seconds after discovery began; Hub's deadline began earlier, before search/load/document retrieval, so it cancels first. This is a control-flow proof for that reproducible input/transport condition, not a claim that current upstream always has those timings.
blockingFindingsInFiniteScope.impact: No DiziYou stream callbacks reach Hub, including already-discovered native fallbacks; prior progressive native delivery did not wait for fallback discovery/probes. Hub also requires its own downstream preflight time.
blockingFindingsInFiniteScope.existingTestGap: DiziYouDeliveryTest covers fast default discovery or shortened discovery/preflight overrides, not eight candidates under default budgets nested inside Hub's 30-second deadline
blockingFindingsInFiniteScope.minimalCorrectionDirection: Reduce DiziYou-only default discovery/preflight budgets, e.g. 8000/6000 ms, leaving room for enclosing search/load/document and Hub downstream checks; add a virtual-time regression using actual defaults, two native plus six fallback candidates, slow probes, and a 30000 ms enclosing timeout. Verify at least a native fallback reaches the delivery boundary before cancellation, plus downstream Hub preflight where feasible. Do not enlarge shared global budgets or bypass external cancellation.
blockingFindingsInFiniteScope.validationMethod: Actual-source deadline composition inspection; no network, source edits, or repeated build/test gates
